Reactive Global Store

Flutcom includes a lightweight in-memory state manager that allows you to share data (like session tokens, shopping carts, or preferences) between all your views instantly. It works with a publisher/subscriber model.

1. Read and Write (Getter/Setter)

The store is exposed globally at window.flutcomApp.store:

const store = window.flutcomApp.store;
 
 // Write or update a value
 store.set('theme', 'dark');
 
 // Read current value
 const theme = store.get('theme');

2. Subscribe to Changes

You can subscribe a function to run automatically every time a value in the store changes. This is perfect for updating the user interface (UI) reactively, like the counter in the Home of this framework:

store.subscribe((key, val) => {
  if (key === 'cartTotal') {
    document.getElementById('cart-badge').textContent = val;
  }
});
